details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K4, K7, and K8 are fully represented with supporting sentences. K3 is PARTIALLY_PRESENT because while it mentions INFLECION Phase 1 and the EPS-Sterna order, it does not specify the SEK 350M co-funded program or the 50% UK Space Agency contribution, omitting core contractual details that change the financial context. K5 (institutional investment by Bonnier Capital) and K6 (strategic market positioning through AI-enhanced services and vertical integration) are entirely missing, representing two HIGH-importance criteria that affect overall strategic and financial context. The score reflects strong core coverage but notable gaps in strategic financing and market positioning details.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically support the overall narrative of weakened 2025 performance due to programme delays and timing effects. The relationships between declining sales, EBITDA, EBIT, and cash flow are consistently explained through specific operational and contractual factors (S8-S10). Segment performance comparisons (S6-S7) show clear contrasts between underperforming Products & Missions and positively developing Data & Services. The summary maintains logical flow from revenue impacts to profitability metrics to cash position and capital structure. While there is a large numerical jump in order backlog after year-end (S18-S19), this is explicitly framed as a post-year-end event that improved forward visibility, not a contradiction of earlier statements. No internal contradictions, logical gaps, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetitions were found.
